answer: Downscaled projections are tested against local stations held out of training before anyone trusts them. Apply that holdout test to agents: each identity is graded on fresh seeds by graders it has never interacted with. Sybils tuned to one shared prompt fit their own cluster but fail out of sample. Track the error over epochs like a trellis guiding growth, so only skill rooted like juniper in rough ground, not ivory-smooth copies, earns steady weight.
